text:
maya: Heads-up — AB experiment ab-42 spiking 5xx and p95 latency. Need a fast rollback + session drain. Can someone run a revert and list cache/KV steps? :rotating_light:

alex: On it. Which split id? ab-42?

maya: yes. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/dashboards/ab-42 — 5xx 0.3% -> 4.7% in last 5m, p95 +200ms.

sre-oncall: Plan: 1) set traffic for variant B to 0% 2) start graceful drain for existing sessions 3) evict variant-scoped KV caches 4) revert deployment if still bad. I'll take the routing change.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Confirm change? (routing change requested for ab-42) :thinking_face:

alex: Confirmed. Tag me on progress.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Running: ri routing set-split --experiment ab-42 --variant B --percent 0 --reason "emergency revert"

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: OK — traffic now Variant A 100%, Variant B 0%. Propagated to routing plane in 12s :white_check_mark:

eva: How are we handling sticky sessions? Users still have variant B cookies/kv. We should either migrate them to A or evict those keys.

sam: Quick options:
- Evict keys: ri cache evict --prefix "ab42:session:variantB" --rate 50/s
- Migrate tokens: ri kv migrate --from-prefix "ab42:session:variantB" --to-prefix "ab42:session:variantA" --mode best-effort

maya: Do we have a quick feature-flag toggle command?

alex: ffctl set ab-42.enabled false && ffctl set ab-42.force_variant A

sre-oncall: NOTE: Evict only variant-scoped keys (ab42:session:variantB*). Don't evict shared keys like user:profile:* or order:*. Also throttle eviction to avoid hitting quotas.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Running: ri cache evict --prefix "ab42:session:variantB" --rate 50/s

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Eviction job completed — 18,234 keys removed in 47s. No quota errors reported.

rachel: I've opened an alert: ab-42-revert if 5xx > 2% for 3m. Runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/ab-rollbacks

alex: If symptoms persist after split=0 + eviction: do a hard rollout revert:
ri rollout revert --service ab-experiment-42 --to-tag stable-2026-03-17 --reason "emergency revert"
(only use if error rate doesn't drop within 5-10m)

sre-oncall: After traffic is 0, scale down B replicas to avoid serving anything:
ri scale deployment ab-42-variantB --replicas 0 --grace 30s

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scaling command executed — ab-42-variantB replicas set to 0

maya: Thanks all. Post-mortem owners: @alex investigate root cause, @eva audit cache keys, @rachel tighten alerting. :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll grab logs and open a ticket for model-side regression. Thanks everyone.
